XenotypeDef.label: World Eater
XenotypeDef.description: Every space marine is defined by the gene-seed of their Primarch. This marine is of the lineage of the XIIth Legion Primarch, Angron, now a daemon prince of Khorne who leads his damned yet indefatigable sons against the Imperium.
